column1: # Remaining unnamed game functions (28 Oct 2026). Short descriptions come from a quick reading of the decompile and the call sites; none has a contract yet.

column4: advances the animation: reads the game clock, steps frames by their durations, wraps or stops at the range end (86 lines, detail not yet contracted)
flags: clear bit0, set bit1; +0x10 = clock now
adds the paused duration to +8, clears +0x10, flags: clear bit1, set bit0
copies bank index (+0x32) to +4 and the player's flags (+0x18) to +8; restored by Obj_ApplyPendingAnim
(camera, target) moves the camera toward a target using the game clock; ends in Camera_SetPositionClamped
stores x,y (+0x2c,+0x30) clamped to the bounds rect (+0x1c..+0x28) with the 640x480 half extents 0x140/0xf0; returns whether it was inside
stores one dword at +0
shifts the interface level camera and its objects by -0x280 (one screen)
moves the interface camera +0x285 and runs the display effect (4, 100)
allocates the index buffer (0xd7a0 bytes, from arena 0) into global 00442068
current position of the archive stream (low dword of fgetpos)
(offset) returns the previous position and seeks to offset

reads 0x1c-byte index records from the .TRE keeping those with flag 4, copies the uppercased name (0x13 bytes) and offset+4 into 0x18-byte entries, then sorts them by name (selection sort); entry count in +0
creates the shared DirectInput object (DirectInputCreateA) and shows "DIRECTINPUT: error al crear el objeto" on failure; reference-counted in 0044207c
true when the device pointer (+4) and the DirectInput object exist
+0xc and +0x10 (200 and 20000 are the values given at start)
(new states, count) state machine per key (0,1,2,4,8,0x10,0x20) using GetTickCount and the two timing values (+0xc, +0x10): press, hold, release and repeat
releases the DirectInput device and the shared DirectInput object when the count reaches zero
0x38-byte keyboard device, vtable 00428070, 16-byte state buffer (+0x1c), default timings 200 and 20000
(track, flag) MCI: stop, set time format to tracks, play from the track (to the next track or the end)
on MM_MCINOTIFY success restarts the saved track (+0x29)
true when the first two fields are set
finds the active sound slot whose id (+0x2c) matches
(archive offset, ...) reads a RIFF/WAVE header from the archive, fills the next sound slot (DirectSoundBuffer), sets volume and pan, starts playing and returns a new id
per-frame: refills streaming buffers (Sound_StreamRefill) and retires finished slots
reads the sound data chunk from the archive into the slot
stops the slot's buffer (slot 0x48/0x34 calls) and clears its id
refills a streaming DirectSound buffer from the archive; returns whether the sound is still active
copy constructor of a script-block entry (vtable 00428078)
field-by-field copy of an entry (used by DialogueTable_Load for kind 1)
if walking (+0xd5) applies the stored facing again via slot 29
for every room, moves the camera toward the room's focus point and re-sorts its objects
writes the object keys and flags and calls each object's SaveState (slot 10) via fwrite
reads object key + flags records until a zero key and calls LoadState (slot 9) on the matching object
rewinds pool arena 2, reloads the deferred animation images of every bank and sets +0x94
base object ctor with vtable 0042b9c0
resets a list's iterator (current = head, first flag = 1)
(key lo, key hi) finds an object in the list by its 64-bit name key at object +0x44; returns 0 when absent
empties a 2-field-node list
like InsertByPriority but inserts before nodes of equal priority
walks the list calling Object_AttachToLevel on each object
empties a 3-field-node list (priority lists)
draws the current phrase text twice (shadow style) at the speaker's position with Display_DrawText, keeping the camera in view
AddSprite helper for image type 1: builds per-scanline entries (177 lines)
rasterises queued type-A rows (215 lines)
AddSprite helper for image type 3
rasterises queued type-B rows
AddSprite helper writing the second row buffer (+0x674)
rasterises the mask rows
DirectDraw setup constructor (0x13a4 bytes)
primary surface pointer set
(font, text, colour/limits, x, y, width, ...) renders a string with the game font into the frame
rasterises one scanline using the three type rasterisers
(effect, speed) starts a screen transition (called with (4, 100) after level changes); uses GetTickCount
first stage of Display_Compose (282 lines)
clears surfaces via DirectDraw (slot 0x80/4 and 0x1c Blt) and resets the render queue
later stage of Display_Compose
per-frame composition: runs raster stages and presents (flip) the frame
sorts 16-byte table records by their 64-bit key
(key lo, key hi) binary search in the sorted table; returns the record or 0
(ms) spins on GetTickCount until the time has passed
second time-driven random function: 7 permuted bits of GetTickCount scaled to (max-min+1), plus min
enters the stage level with Jim, shows him, and starts a dialogue entry by key
allocates a node and links it at the list head
(lo, hi, buffer) rebuilds a readable name from a 64-bit key; used for error text
scores a move on a 7-column board (columns hold up to 7 pieces, lines of 4): hypothesis for a board mini-game
toggles a blink flag every 200 ms of game time and updates board objects; hypothesis
tries each non-full column, collects the best-scoring columns
picks a column (checks for immediate win/loss first, then best-scoring, using RandomRange to break ties)
